subject: Glacier Health: Short customer showcase + live demo at Redwood Forum
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Novak <claire@glacierhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Glacier Health: Short customer showcase + live demo at Redwood Forum

Hi Claire —

Hope you and the product team are doing well. I'd like to invite Glacier Health to join a short customer showcase slot at our upcoming Redwood Forum (virtual + small in-person hub in SF) on Sep 22. The idea: 15 minutes for a concise case study followed by a 10-minute live demo/Q&A where the Glacier team walks through a specific production workflow you built on Redwood.

Why we think this fits:
- Your deployment story (low-latency inference at scale for patient triage) is tightly aligned with what many clients want to hear.
- We'll feature Glacier in promotional materials and a one-page case study we'll share post-event.

Proposed speaker package: 15-minute talk + 10-minute live Q&A, honorarium of $1,500, and a short pre-event prep call (30 min). We'll provide a one-pager and slide template. Attached is a draft speaker brief and a mutual action plan so we can line up approvals and timing.

Are you open to this? If yes I'd be grateful if you can confirm by next week and we'll get an NDA/DocuSign rolling if required. Happy to set a 20-minute pre-call to run through logistics.

Thanks,
Priyom Das
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
priyom@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0147

Attachments: redwood-speaker-brief.pdf (1 page), glacier-mutual-action-plan.xlsx (workback schedule)

From: Claire Novak <claire@glacierhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Glacier Health: Short customer showcase + live demo at Redwood Forum

Hi Priyom —

Thanks for the invite and for thinking of Glacier. The topic sounds valuable for our product team and we'd be interested in participating in a customer showcase. A couple quick questions from our side before I confirm:

1) Does Redwood require a signed NDA for the pre-event prep materials and slide vetting? Our legal team typically needs to review any external speaker materials.
2) Can you share the exact agenda and timeframe we'll have? 25 minutes total (15 + 10) works, but we'd like clarity on whether the demo will be live on stage (we may need a non-prod key).
3) Is the honorarium a payment to Glacier or to individual speakers (we usually route payments through procurement)?

If you can answer those, I'll run it by procurement and legal. Also copying our events mailbox to coordinate availability.

Best,
Claire Novak
VP Product, Glacier Health
claire@glacierhealth.com | (617) 555-0192
